mating_cylinder.label: Rod socket, pressure web, guide pins and stop

instructions.title: Contact-sensing assembly
instructions.text: Use all v9 parts. Stick sensor to foot without covering active area or vent. Attach TPU pad to cylinder web. Guides must slide freely; do not glue them. Stretch collar cuffs into both grooves with wire window aligned. Rod seats against closed web. Measure film plus adhesive and set pad gap with thin shims. Bench-test release, touch threshold, tilted contact and hard stop.
